title: Sprint 1 – Understanding the Project & Fixing Core API Issues
description: Sprint Goal: Become familiar with the project structure, understand how the existing APIs work, and resolve the most critical issues preventing the application from functioning correctly.

tickets.title: Ticket 1 – Fix Project Setup Issues
tickets.description:
The Django project fails to start because several configuration problems exist. Investigate the application and resolve all startup issues so the development server runs successfully.

Expected Work
Fix incorrect imports.
Resolve missing or broken app configurations.
Fix invalid URL configurations.
Apply pending migrations.
Ensure the project starts without errors.
learning_objectives: Understand Ticket 1 – Fix Project Setup Issues

tasks.title: Complete Ticket 1 – Fix Project Setup Issues

tickets.title: Ticket 2 – Repair Broken CRUD APIs
tickets.description:
Several API endpoints do not perform Create, Read, Update, or Delete operations correctly. Some APIs return incorrect data, while others fail completely.

Expected Work
Fix Create APIs.
Fix Update operations.
Fix Delete functionality.
Ensure correct database records are modified.
Verify API responses after every operation.
learning_objectives: Understand Ticket 2 – Repair Broken CRUD APIs

tasks.title: Complete Ticket 2 – Repair Broken CRUD APIs

tickets.title: Ticket 3 – Correct HTTP Status Codes
tickets.description:
Many APIs always return HTTP 200 regardless of success or failure. Update every endpoint so it follows REST API standards.

Expected Work
Return 201 after successful resource creation.
Return 204 after successful deletion.
Return 400 for invalid requests.
Return 401 for unauthorized access.
Return 403 for forbidden actions.
Return 404 when resources are not found.
Return appropriate server error responses.
learning_objectives: Understand Ticket 3 – Correct HTTP Status Codes

tasks.title: Complete Ticket 3 – Correct HTTP Status Codes

tickets.title: Ticket 4 – Fix Serializer Validation
tickets.description:
The application accepts invalid input data because serializer validations are incomplete or missing.

Expected Work
Validate required fields.
Prevent duplicate records.
Reject invalid email addresses.
Prevent negative values.
Display meaningful validation errors.

tickets.title: Ticket 5 – Standardize API Responses
tickets.description:
Different APIs return inconsistent response formats, making frontend integration difficult.

Expected Work
Implement a common response format.
Standardize success responses.
Standardize error responses.
Ensure every endpoint follows the same structure.

tickets.title: Ticket 6 – Fix Search, Filter and Ordering APIs
tickets.description:
Filtering and searching APIs produce incorrect results or ignore request parameters.

Expected Work
Repair search functionality.
Fix ordering.
Correct filtering logic.
Handle invalid query parameters gracefully.
learning_objectives: Understand Ticket 6 – Fix Search, Filter and Ordering APIs

tasks.title: Complete Ticket 6 – Fix Search, Filter and Ordering APIs

tickets.title: Ticket 7 – Fix Pagination Issues
tickets.description:
Large datasets are returned without pagination, causing slow API responses and unnecessary data transfer.

Expected Work
Implement pagination.
Configure page size.
Return pagination metadata.
Verify navigation between pages.
